sources.title: Maple-Preview - AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Maple-Preview is a 20B-parameter mixture-of-experts language model using ternary weights, built for efficient on-device reasoning. It supports a 131,072-token context window and is designed to run fast on consumer hardware such as Apple Silicon Macs and iPhones, reportedly reaching over 200 tokens per second on an M4 Mac mini.
